text:
maya: dropping notes from today's micro design review for autoscale control bar. Goal: refine min/max ergonomics and surface guardrails without overwhelming new users.
simon: quick signal: users on support calls keep asking what 'Min (reserved)' actually means. Could we show a tiny badge 'Billed' next to it?
anya: yes — propose label: 'Min (Reserved) • Billed' and tooltip: 'Reserved capacity is billed even if unused. Use only if you need guaranteed baseline.'
ken: contrast nit: the 'Billed' badge current orange on light theme is < 4.5:1 against white. Need darker orange or different stroke.
maya: noted. Also UX: when users adjust SLO slider beyond safety guardrail, show inline microcopy: 'High latency target may require more capacity; enabling burst is recommended.' with a CTA link 'Enable burst'.
simon: small copy tweak: callouts like 'Enable burst' should be verb-first. Good.
anya: regarding pool picker, can we show three bits of metadata inline: region, GPU type, median latency? e.g., 'us-west2 • A100 • 42ms'. Helps ops pick quickly.
ken: keyboard: pool picker options need role="option" and proper aria-selected updates. Last build lost that.
maya: validation UX for min/max: show computed 'Estimated baseline workers: X' below fields, and update live as user types. If Min = 0, show helper: 'Setting min to 0 may increase cold-starts'.
simon: agreed. Also, math example is helpful: 'Example: min=1, burst=2 => peak=3' right under the fields in muted text.
anya: for runbook-friendly copy: add a 'Why choose this setting?' toggle that expands a 3-bullet rationale: cost, latency, availability. Collapsed by default for advanced users.
ken: a11y: the toggle must be keyboard focusable and state persisted across step navigation if opened.
design-labs-bot: Please review autoscale-guardrails.md in the design drive.
maya: one visual thought: we currently use a red border for violating guardrails; switch to an inline warning pill with an icon and message to reduce visual churn.
simon: pill makes sense. Also when offering 'Auto-fix: set Max to 2x Min' make the action more explicit: 'Auto-fix Max to 2 × Min'.
anya: copy for canary: 'Canary rollout: percentage of requests directed to pool' — show default 5% and note 'Auto rollback on error surge'.
ken: SLO slider aria-label strategy: include unit: 'Latency (median) in milliseconds slider'. Also ensure the tooltip with exact ms value appears in DOM for screen readers.
maya: next steps: I'll update the figma with the badge copy and pill warnings, simon will add pool metadata rows, ken will audit focus order, anya will draft final microcopy text.
anya: deadline: prototype by Tuesday EOD. Will ping design review channel when ready.
simon: will review copy inline.
ken: will run axe on the prototype once posted.
maya: thanks team, closing out.
